tone.quote: The men from Rantau Pulut said the Kohin spoken in Upper Seruyan County was the same as they spoke. However, the women in Marandang said that the people in Rantau Pulut have a somewhat different accent, tone, and pronunciation.
tone.locator: p.10, section 4.1.2 'Results' of the group questionnaire
tone.says: No phonology or suprasegmental section at all (contents: previous work, survey area, observations, questionnaires, 275-word lexical-similarity matrix without the lists, comprehension testing). The only occurrence of 'tone' is a lay sociolinguistic remark by Marandang women that Rantau Pulut speakers have 'a somewhat different accent, tone, and pronunciation' (p.10); no claim about lexical tone or stress. Does not decide the tone question.
